title: Grievance categories
content: Grievances are categorized as Academic, Hostel, Financial, Harassment, or Administrative. Category must be specified for correct routing.

title: Priority handling
content: Harassment and safety-related grievances are always treated as high priority and escalated directly to the Dean's office within 24 hours, bypassing normal queue order.

title: Response SLA
content: Standard grievances receive an initial response within 3 working days. Resolution timelines vary by complexity and are communicated to the student directly.

title: Confidentiality
content: Grievance details are visible only to the submitting student and authorized reviewers. They are never disclosed to other students or unrelated staff.
